title: Folder previews are affected by keyboard shortcuts which manipulate windows
line: Folder preview popups on the desktop can no longer be maximized, minimized, moved or sent to another virtual desktop with window shortcuts.
explanation: The Folder View preview popup (FolderViewDialog, a PlasmaQuick::Dialog) kept the default Normal window type, so KWin managed it as an ordinary window: Meta+PgUp maximized it, Meta+PgDn minimized it, Meta+drag moved it and desktop shortcuts sent it elsewhere. The change sets its type to AppletPopup, the role other Plasma popups use; KWin then treats it as non-movable, non-maximizable, non-minimizable and on all desktops.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: make folder preview popups applet popups

Folder preview popups were created as normal windows, so window manager
shortcuts could maximize, minimize, move or send them to another virtual
desktop. They now use the applet popup type, like other Plasma popups.

BUG: 508124

From b3e3312b4b3e437ee412436e4ef686ee0f901581 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>

Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: make folder preview popups applet
 popups

Folder preview popups were created as normal windows, so window manager
shortcuts could maximize, minimize, move or send them to another virtual
desktop. They now use the applet popup type, like other Plasma popups.

BUG: 508124
---
 containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewDialog.qml | 1 +
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewDialog.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewDialog.qml
index 2a4c4af6d6..481c8fa81d 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewDialog.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewDialog.qml
@@ -37,6 +37,7 @@ Folder.SubDialog {
 
     property alias url: folderView.url
 
+    type: PlasmaCore.Dialog.AppletPopup
     location: PlasmaCore.Types.Floating
     hideOnWindowDeactivate: (allowClosing && (childDialog === null))
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Preview of folder A open, then Meta+PgUp: the popup is maximized to the whole work area
Same steps with the fix: Meta+PgUp does nothing, the popup stays as it was

review.text: Setting type: PlasmaCore.Dialog.AppletPopup on FolderViewDialog.qml fixes the root cause cleanly in one line so KWin no longer treats folder preview popups as normal maximizable/minimizable/movable windows. Leaving Alt+F4 able to close the popup is consistent with all other Plasma applet popups and is honestly documented in the commit and notes. Verification thoroughly covers keyboard focus, Escape, nested previews, and dismissal.
